sections.purpose: Three pricing tiers in a grid layout
sections.copy: Starter (Recommended) | Pro | Team | Each tier includes: name, price ($/month), short blurb, feature list with inline-SVG checks, and a CTA button. Starter is highlighted with a subtle border and scale.
Columns include: Feature Name, Starter, Pro, Team. Features include: Unlimited Boards, 5 Team Members, Priority Support, Advanced Analytics, and Custom Branding.
Questions: Can I upgrade my plan? What happens if I exceed my team limit? Is there a free trial? Each question is wrapped in <details> tags.

sections.purpose: Final CTA band with a call to action
sections.copy: Start your free trial today and experience the power of Bloomboard
